title: Fix Framework Core RS TS-RS Freshness Check CWD Path Construction
description: Fix path construction in framework-core-rs script.ts (cwd, bindingsDir, generatedManifestPath) to reflect flat directory layout and verify framework-core-rs:check passes.
summary: Verified and confirmed that framework-core-rs script.ts uses the flat layout paths (cwd: root, bindingsDir: join(root, 'bindings'), generatedManifestPath: join(root, '..', '🟦️typescript', 'generated', 'manifest.ts')). Confirmed `bun nx run @semio-tech/framework-core-rs:check` passes clean and `bun ./📜️script.ts verify` gate successfully passes the ts-rs binding freshness check.
